name: Maestro Fresh Wes
description: '''Wesley''' "'''Wes'''" '''Williams''' (born March 31, 1968) is a [[Canadians|Canadian]] rapper, singer, record producer, actor, and author. He is known professionally by his stage names '''Maestro Fresh Wes''' (formerly '''Maestro Fresh-Wes''') or '''Maestro''' as a musician, and is credited by his birth name as an actor. One of the earliest Canadian rappers to achieve mainstream success, he is credited as the "Godfather of [[Canadian hip hop]]". His debut album, ''[[Symphony in Effect]]'' (1989), was the first certified platinum album by a [[Black Canadians|Black Canadian]] artist, and his 2023 induction into the [[Canadian Music Hall of Fame]] and 2024 [[Governor General's Performing Arts Award]] were each the first for any hip-hop artist.
